description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/carbon_footprint.xlsx. The sheet contains household consumption data in columns A-B and conversion factors in columns E-F. Create formulas in column C (cells C2:C6) to calculate emissions by multiplying consumption (column B) by the corresponding conversion factor (column F). In cell C8, create a SUM formula to calculate total emissions: =SUM(C2:C6). In column D (cells D2:D6), create percentage formulas showing each category's contribution to total: =C2/$C$8*100 (and similar for other rows, using absolute reference $C$8). Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
